title: High-Quality Travel Pillow Is Difficult to Bag
text:
High-Quality Travel Pillow Is Difficult to Bag. This HAOBAIMEI TRAVEL NECK PILLOW (Memory Foam, Grey) is a high-quality, well-made travel pillow that can be positioned in myriad ways to support your head/neck comfortably in all kinds of seating. However, it’s bulky--about the size of a small loaf of bread when bagged. The bagged pillow is also an awkward shape (and a little heavy) to carry everywhere you go.

The memory foam provides solid support. However, the pillow is much more difficult to bag than the product video suggests. Bagging requires hand strength and sitting down so you can force the folded pillow into the bag.

A bonus thin sleep mask is included, but it isn’t very effective in blocking out light. It’s just a flat piece of padded black satin fabric.
